claims.claim_text: Independent testing laboratory confirmed in December 2025 that the AI-1 smartphone battery delivered volumetric energy density of 935 Wh/L, exceeding the performance of a leading silicon-doped commercially available smartphone battery tested by 12%.
claims.subject: Enovix AI-1 smartphone battery
claims.source_quote: An independent testing laboratory confirmed in December 2025 that the AI-1 smartphone battery delivered a volumetric energy density of 935Wh/L, exceeding the performance of a leading silicon-doped commercially available smartphone battery tested by 12%.

claims.claim_text: Cell architecture is designed to enable silicon anodes to achieve a minimum of 1,000 complete charge/discharge cycles to 80% remaining capacity.
claims.subject: Enovix silicon-anode cell architecture
claims.source_quote: the constraint system in our cell architecture is designed to enable silicon anodes to achieve a minimum of 1,000 complete charge/discharge cycles to 80% remaining capacity.

claims.subject: Enovix
claims.object_value: 1 lead smartphone OEM (unnamed); 1 lead eyewear customer + 9 other OEM/ODMs

claims.claim_text: Fab2 in Penang Science Park, Malaysia is operational with three lines (R&D pilot, Agility, HVM); commenced shipping cells from Agility line in October 2024; Site Acceptance Testing complete for Agility and HVM by end of 2024.
claims.subject: Enovix Fab2 (Penang, Malaysia)
claims.object_value: 3 lines operational; Agility shipping since Oct-2024; SAT complete YE-2024
claims.source_quote: We now have three manufacturing lines at Fab2: the R&D focused pilot production line, the Agility line and the High-Volume Manufacturing ( HVM ) line. In October 2024, we commenced shipping battery cells from the Agility line and by the end of 2024, we had completed Site Acceptance Testing ( SAT ) for the Agility and HVM lines.
claims.note: Malaysia Fab2 — EPA FRS would not register a Malaysian site; no US production facility to check via EPA FRS.

claims.claim_text: Acquired Routejade (South Korea battery manufacturer) in 2023 and adjacent battery cell manufacturing facility from SolarEdge in 2025; total Korean manufacturing footprint 467,400 sqft owned.
claims.subject: Enovix South Korea operations
claims.object_value: 467,400 sqft owned (Korea); two acquisitions: Routejade (2023) and SolarEdge-adjacent facility (2025)
claims.source_quote: we acquired Routejade, Inc. ( Routejade ), a battery manufacturer in South Korea... In 2025, we further expanded our manufacturing capabilities in South Korea through the acquisition of an adjacent battery cell manufacturing facility and related equipment from Solar Edge.

claims.claim_text: Defense and industrial markets growing through Korea operations: drones, subsea systems, munitions; reportedly increasing shipments.
claims.subject: Enovix defense / industrial product line
claims.object_value: growing shipments; named end-uses: drones / subsea / munitions
claims.source_quote: In defense and industrial markets, we continued to support growing customer demand through expanded production capabilities and increased shipments from our South Korea operations... drones, subsea systems, and munitions defense systems.

claims.claim_text: Going-concern adjacent distress markers: accumulated deficit $977.8M as of 12/28/2025; FY25 = $60M share buyback executed; new $75M repurchase authorized subsequent; 2028 + 2030 Convertible Senior Notes outstanding; ATM in place; warrant dividend issued July 2025 (expired August 2025).
claims.subject: Enovix capital structure
claims.object_value: accumulated deficit $977.8M; working capital $477.2M; convertibles 2028 (3.00%) + 2030 (4.75%); warrant dividend issued/expired in 2025
claims.source_quote: As of December 28, 2025, we had working capital of $ 477.2 million and an accumulated deficit of $ 977.8 million... we expect to continue to incur operating losses in the near term. ... The accompanying consolidated financial statements have been prepared assuming we will continue as a going concern...

claims.claim_text: Securities class action (N.D. Cal., consolidated In re Enovix Corp. Securities Litigation, 23-cv-00071-SI) alleges material misstatements about manufacturing scale-ups and equipment testing; one statement remains active after Oct 2025 partial dismissal; class cert hearing March 2026.
claims.subject: Enovix legal proceedings
claims.object_value: active 10(b)/Rule 10b-5 claims re: manufacturing/equipment-test statements; class period 2021-08-10 to 2023-10-03; class cert hearing March 2026
claims.source_quote: alleges violations of Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act, and Rule 10b-5 promulgated thereunder, relating to alleged material misstatements or omissions in public statements related to our manufacturing scale-ups and testing of new equipment... A hearing on the plaintiffs renewed motion for class certification is expected to be held in March 2026.
